HMACAuth.name: Authorization
HMACAuth.description:
# HMAC Authentication 
Authorization using a secret key and signature content. To use HMAC authentication, clients need to generate an HMAC signature using their secret key. The signature should be included in the `Authorization` header as follows:
```
HMAC-SHA512 SignedHeaders=x-bwell-date;host;x-bwell-client-user-token;x-bwell-client-key;x-bwell-content-sha512&Signature=<hmac-sha512-signature>
```
## Authorization Assembly
In order to assemble the proper headers for HMAC authorization the following data is required:
- HTTP Method
- HTTP Path + Query Params
- UTC Timestamp in RFC1123 format
- DNS Host
- bwell Client Key
- Client User Token
- Content Hash
### Content Hash
The content hash is created by computing the SHA512 hash of the request content (an empty string is the intended content for a request with an empty body) and then converting the hash bytes into a Base64 string representation.
### Signature 
The HMAC signature is created by computing by HMAC SHA512 hash of the below template string followed by converting the hash bytes into a Base64 string representation:
```
"$REQUEST_METHOD\n$REQUEST_PATH_AND_QUERY\n$TIMESTAMP;$DNS_HOST;$BWELL_CLIENT_USER_TOKEN;BWELL_CLIENT_KEY;$CONTENT_HASH"
```
NOTE: The HMAC SHA512 created here will use the shared bwell client secret.
##### Example
```
"POST\n/users/123/data-export\nSun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT;api.yourservice.com;123456789;123456789;z4PhNX7vuL3xVChQ1m2AB9Yg5AULVxXcg/SpIdNs6c5H0NE8XYXysP+DGNKHfuwvY7kxvUdBeoGlODJ6+SfaPg="
```
NOTE:
- Content hash above is SHA512 Base64 representation of an empty string.
- Client key above is `123456789`.
- Client user token above is `123456789`
### Attach Headers
With all required data now computed attach the headers to the request.
##### x-bwell-date
```
Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:37 GMT
```
##### x-bwell-client-user-token (example below)
```
123456789
```
##### x-bwell-client-key (example below)
```
123456789 
```
##### x-bwell-content-sha512
```
z4PhNX7vuL3xVChQ1m2AB9Yg5AULVxXcg/SpIdNs6c5H0NE8XYXysP+DGNKHfuwvY7kxvUdBeoGlODJ6+SfaPg=
```
##### Authorization
```
HMAC-SHA512 SignedHeaders=x-bwell-date;host;x-bwell-client-user-token;x-bwell-client-key;x-bwell-content-sha512&Signature=6aJFRj3g/vtp2VchaokB+sfOUrDfPGKhcErIh68D7m/WaJpIoThSraiT8Nj8uE+B8AU+WqXfW2ajHpZCDahhOA==
```
NOTE: Many HTTP clients will attach the `Host` header by default. Make sure this is the case for the HTTP client used to interface with this API.
